source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.8.1 (PDF 222), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Innovation naye ideas, products ya tareeqe banane ka process hai jo significant (bari, saaf nazar aane wali) tabdeeli ya behtari laayein. Yeh sirf bilkul nayi cheez invent (ijad) karna nahi, balke pehle se maujood cheezon ko behtar, tez ya zyada efficient (kam waqt aur kam kharche mein zyada kaam karne wala) banana bhi innovation hai.

Misal: Pakistan mein mobile banking innovation ki misal hai. Pehle logon ko transactions (len den) ke liye khud bank jana parta tha, jis mein waqt lagta tha aur mushkil hoti thi, khaas taur par rural (dehati, gaon ke) ilaqon ke logon ke liye. Ab mobile banking se log apne mobile phone se hi paise bhejte aur receive (wusool) karte hain, bill ada karte hain aur baqi banking ke kaam karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Karobar mein innovation asal mein kis bare mein hai (MCQ 10)?
blocks.explanation: (b) Existing (pehle se maujood) products aur processes (kaam ke tareeqon) ko behtar banana. Kitab zor deti hai ke innovation sirf bilkul nayi cheez invent karna nahi, balke pehle se maujood cheezon ko behtar banana bhi hai.

items: Innovation: naye ya behtar ideas, products aur tareeqe (mobile banking).
